collection.title: Porsche 911 Convertible 2005 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Porsche 911 Convertible 2005 to 2011 (997) will fit, this model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
